__comment: The Stonemason's own workbench (doc 293): a split stone slab, never dressed, laid across two log stumps with their root flares, three blocks long (owner, 2026-11-01). Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs.
Stonemasons make it at the crude workbench from a log and three Rough Stones. Like the hearth it keeps no wood identity. The slab's top stands 0.9375 blocks high inside the 3 x 1 collision envelope.

Its window's Craft items opens the Stonemason's page (crafting_recipe). Stone stools are made here: the Rough Stone lies on the slab where it is nearest the Stonemason, crafting_surface_inset inside its edges.
description: A split stone slab laid across two log stumps: the Stonemason's own workbench, where rough stone is knocked square. Occupies a 3 by 1 space and is worked from either long side.
